lines: Devang Mehta (Investor Selling Shareholder) may sell up to 16,650 shares in the offer for sale, with proceeds of up to ₹2.25 crore if all offered shares are sold; the employee-portion shares are sold at a discount, so actual proceeds are slightly lower.
The timing is at listing, with trading start printed as March 11, 2026, which makes a call timely now, ahead of the listing.
Potential gain is up to ₹1.66 crore before offer expenses and taxes, and retained holding is an estimated ₹5.25 crore at offer price.
Confidence is medium: the name is verified in the seller table, but holdings were found in one section only (promoter_holding).
